entity.title: Spirit Bomb Super Saiyan
entity.known_users: Future Trunks, Goku, Ultra Fusion, Vegeta, Dragon Ball Fusions, Dragon Ball Z: Shin Budokai, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2
entity.description: Spirit Bomb Super Saiyan is the result of a Super Saiyan becoming empowered via absorbing a Spirit Bomb.

instructions.question: What kind of entity is `entity.title` on this wiki?
instructions.focus: Judge the entity itself, not the beings who happen to have used it.

criteria.technique: A learned or performed move, attack or skill the being uses.
criteria.transformation: A form the being's body reaches and changes into.
criteria.power_up: A temporary boost that amplifies the being without being a form of its own.
criteria.fusion: A being or state that exists only because two or more beings merged.
criteria.trait: An inherent characteristic, physical property or innate feature, not something performed.
criteria.media: An episode, chapter, film, game or other publication.
criteria.unknown: None of the above, or the page does not say enough to tell.

instructions.question: Can only members of one species, race or clan ever have `entity.title`?
instructions.focus: Judge the entity itself, not the beings who happen to have used it.

criteria.true: Only one race can have it. A form that needs a trigger (a full moon, a ritual) is still race-exclusive if only that race responds to the trigger.
criteria.false: Beings of more than one race can have it, or it is not tied to race.

instructions.question: Does `entity.title` come from what the being is?
instructions.focus: Judge the entity itself, not the beings who happen to have used it.

criteria.true: It comes from the being's own nature. Latent potential that another character draws out is still intrinsic: the power was already theirs.
criteria.false: It is learned, given, or comes from outside the being.

instructions.question: Does the power of `entity.title` itself come from a source outside the being?
instructions.focus: Judge the entity itself, not the beings who happen to have used it.

criteria.true: It comes from an artifact, a wish, a parasite, a serum, or absorbing another being's energy.
criteria.false: It was already the being's; an outside condition at most triggers something the being already had.

instructions.question: Can another being learn `entity.title` given training or instruction?
instructions.focus: Judge the entity itself, not the beings who happen to have used it.

criteria.true: Others can learn it by training or instruction.
criteria.false: It cannot be taught; it is innate, granted, or unique.

instructions.question: Can `entity.title` be active at the same time as another form, amplifying it?
instructions.focus: Judge the entity itself, not the beings who happen to have used it.

criteria.true: It is active on top of another form and amplifies it.
criteria.false: It replaces the current form, or it is not a form-like state at all.

instructions.question: Does `entity.title` wear off on its own?
instructions.focus: Judge the entity itself, not the beings who happen to have used it.

criteria.true: It ends by itself after a time or once its energy is spent.
criteria.false: It lasts until the being chooses to end it, or it is permanent.

instructions.question: Does obtaining or keeping `entity.title` need an object?
instructions.focus: Judge the entity itself, not the beings who happen to have used it.

criteria.true: An object is needed to obtain it or keep it active.

instructions.question: Does `entity.title` exist only because two or more beings merged?
instructions.focus: Judge the entity itself, not the beings who happen to have used it.

criteria.true: It exists only through two or more beings merging.
criteria.false: No merging of beings is involved.
